cues.zh: 如果你骑着自行车，想向右转，可能会觉得应该把车把
cues.en: If you’re riding a bike and want to turn right, you might think that you should turn

cues.zh: 向右转。
cues.en: the handlebars to the right.

cues.zh: 但这样不对。
cues.en: However, that’s wrong.

cues.zh: 汽车转动车轮，只是改变车头的朝向；自行车却不一样。
cues.en: Because, unlike a car where turning the wheels merely changes the direction the car is pointed,

cues.zh: 转动前轮会让自行车倾斜。
cues.en: turning the front wheel makes a bike lean.

cues.zh: 如果你把自行车前轮向右转，车轮就会向右移，直接从你
cues.en: When you turn the bike wheel to the right, the wheel goes to the right, right out from

cues.zh: 和自行车其他部分的下方滑出去。
cues.en: under you and the rest of the bike.

cues.zh: 这样你就会向左倾斜，地面对自行车的作用力也会
cues.en: So now you’re leaning to the left, and the force on the bike from the ground will be

cues.zh: 指向左边。当然，向左的力会让你向左走。
cues.en: directed to the left, and a leftward force, of course, makes you go to the left.

cues.zh: 既然物理规律似乎非要让你向左走，那你大概最好
cues.en: Since physics seems determined that you’re going left, you’d probably better just give

cues.zh: 顺势而为，也把车把转向左边。
cues.en: in and let the handlebars turn to the left, too.

cues.zh: 这就是骑自行车向左转的方法：先向右转。
cues.en: And that’s how you turn left on a bike – by first turning right.

cues.zh: 如果你真想向右转，一开始就该先向左反向转向。
cues.en: If you really wanted to go right, you should have started by counter-steering to the left.

cues.zh: 等你终于进入右转弯，还得继续用力，
cues.en: Once you finally get yourself into a right turn, you’ll also need to work to keep yourself

cues.zh: 让车保持在弯道中，因为大多数自行车和摩托车都会自动稳定下来，
cues.en: in the turn, since most bikes and motorcycles have a tendency to automatically stabilize

cues.zh: 自行回正。
cues.en: and straighten out on their own.

cues.zh: 这是因为车身向右倾斜时，自行车会自动向更右边转，
cues.en: This happens because a right-leaning bike automatically steers itself even farther to

cues.zh: 让车轮回到重心下方，所以你实际上需要
cues.en: the right to get the wheels back underneath its center of mass, so you’ll actually need

cues.zh: 稍微向左施加扭矩，防止车轮转得太靠右。
cues.en: to apply a slight torque to the left to keep the wheels from turning too far to the right.

cues.zh: 没错，这听起来很反直觉：骑自行车向右转时，你先向左转，然后还得继续
cues.en: Yes, it’s counterintuitive: to turn right on a bike you turn left, then keep trying

cues.zh: 试着向左转，同时倾斜车身向右转弯。
cues.en: to turn left while leaning and turning right.

cues.en: Bikes

cues.en: are weird.
